title: Similar | Incubator Thermal Step-Response Fit
goal: Characterize a benchtop incubator with an open-loop heater step test, fit a first-order thermal response from noisy measurements, and report the model parameters plus the steady heater percentage needed to hold a target culture temperature.
skillBenefitRationale: This stays close to the source skill’s canonical use case: fitting a noisy first-order step response with constrained nonlinear least squares. `scipy.optimize.curve_fit` is the only essential shipped skill for recovering the thermal gain and time constant.
